shell.guard: Chats are protected by AI Guard
notice.banned: Your account is banned for breaking community rules. You can’t send messages or requests.
notice.suspended: Your account is suspended while the team reviews a report. You can’t send messages or requests for now.
notice.warned: You received a warning for breaking community rules. Keep chats respectful and about the project.
theme.title: Appearance
theme.hint: Auto follows your phone or laptop setting.
landing.title: Find the teammate your idea is missing.
landing.lead: Tell us what you want to build and what you’re good at. We match you with students nearby who share your vision and bring the skills you don’t have.
landing.f1.d: Same vision, complementary skills, compatible working style, and close by. Every match tells you why.
landing.f2.d: Verified students, protected chats and a separate Safe Mode for under-18s.
landing.f3.d: Share one line in public, more after a match, and the full plan only with your team.
landing.footer: Made in Bengaluru for students. Your data is never sold.
how.title: How it works
how.1.d: What you want to build, what you are good at, and where you study.
how.2.d: Students nearby whose skills complete yours, with the reasons for every match.
how.3.d: Start with a small trial task, then plan, check in weekly and ship it.
feat.title: Built for first-time builders
login.title: Sign in to BuildMates
login.lead: Use Google or get a sign-in link by email. No passwords to remember.
login.consent: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy. BuildMates uses my data only to run my account, as required by the DPDP Act 2023, and I can delete it any time.
login.emailHint: College email helps you get the Verified badge.
login.needConsent: Please accept the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
login.checkText: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue. Check Spam if you don’t see it in a minute.
ob.hello: Hi! I’m your BuildMates guide. A few quick questions and you’ll see your first matches.
ob.q.name: What should we call you?
ob.q.dob: When were you born? This decides which features you get.
ob.q.place: Where do you study and stay?
ob.q.skills: What are you good at? Pick up to 4.
ob.q.interests: Which areas excite you? Pick up to 4.
ob.q.vision: Describe what you want to build, in your own words. Hindi, English or both is fine.
ob.name: Your name
ob.dobHint: Only used to decide your mode. Others never see your birthday.
ob.minor: You’ll use Safe Mode (age {age}). You’ll match only with students your age, and meetings stay off. A parent needs to approve your account.
ob.areaHint: We never store your exact location. Others only see your college and area.
ob.visionHint: {n}/500 · Skip if you don’t have an idea yet. Describe the problem, not your secret solution.
role.Idea person.d: I have an idea and need people to build it
role.Builder.d: I have skills and want to join a good idea
role.Both.d: I have an idea and can build parts of it
quiz.title: I see myself as…
quiz.lead: Based on the Ten-Item Personality Inventory (TIPI). There are no wrong answers.
m.title: Hi {name}, here are your matches
m.safe: Safe Mode: showing students under 18 only.
m.sorted: Sorted by how well you fit together.
m.addVision: Add your vision to get much better matches.
m.search: Search by name, skill, interest or college
m.noneText: You’re early! As more students from your college join, they’ll show up here. Share BuildMates with friends to grow your circle.
c.title: Chats
c.lead: A chat opens only when both people say yes.
c.noneText: Connect with a match to start talking.
c.sayHi: Say hi and share what you want to build
ct.guard: AI Guard is on. Phone numbers, social IDs and money requests are blocked for the first 7 days.
ct.connected: You’re connected. Keep it about the project and stay kind.
ct.off: Messaging is turned off for your account
ct.minorMeet: Meetings are turned off in Safe Mode. Meet only at school or college events with a teacher.
p.title: Your profile
p.lead: This is what your matches see. Your exact location and birthday are never shown.
p.deleteText: Removes your profile and data. Your right under the DPDP Act 2023.
p.improveText: Four quick questions about BuildMates. Your answers help our college research.
p.installText: Add BuildMates to your home screen. It opens like an app and works with weak internet.
n.title: Notifications
n.lead: Everything that needs you, in one place.
n.noneText: New requests, messages, invites and offers will show here.
pwa.update: A new version of BuildMates is ready.
waiting.title: Waiting for your parent’s approval
waiting.text: Because you’re under 18, a parent needs to approve your account. We’ll contact {email}. This page updates on its own once they approve.
waiting.hidden: Until then, nobody can see your profile.
